notes.title: 2.6.1 Released - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Cleaned up some issues with 2.6.0, more bugs have been identified since this was published so expect a 2.6.2 soon.

bugfix: car spawner was putting cars up in the air
bugfix: vehicles hp, level and armor #'s were not correct sometimes when playing multiplayer
bugfix: multiplayer server was letting players into all dungeons regardless of level
bugfix: zombie spawners were not working correctly
bugfix: vehicle collisions detection now works as intended (update: still one more issue to be resolved - created a new bug tho thats fixed in 2.6.2
tweaks: more zombies in newbton, less in church, more in race track pit area & farm - levels adjusted

notes.title: 2.5.7 Released - Post Launch Bug Fixes, AI Improvements & Tweaks
notes.notes:
- new: new keyboard short cuts to map, armor, creative, crafting, skills, player list, emotes and quick chats
- bugfix: zombies would spawn in t-pose
- bugfix: survivors NPCs would have trouble finding hiding spots (and would waste cpu)
- bugfix: bandit ai was shooting level 0 bullets without effects
- bugfix: bandit ai was not attacking if you damaged them
- bugfix: when driving a vehicle multiplayer, map area wouldnt load until you ejected
- bugfix: cartoonish particle effect on hard landing was reported to crash some mobile devices, on mobile uses a more basic particle effect
- bugfix: map default turrets were respawning all messed up, temp fix: they will no longer respawn
- tweak: replication ranges have been adjusted for PCs with high rendering ability
- tweak: changed darkness so it wasnt so dark - not fun for people, especially when joining a server as new player at night
- tweak: looking at things to high light them wasnt using right start position (better for selecting)

notes.title: 2.5.5 Released - Bugfix + Unreal Engine 4.16.1 Update
notes.notes:
We're on final approach for our Steam launch.  Updated to UE4 4.16.1 for the networking and garbage collection performance boosts, plus fixed a nasty bug in the save/load system

- bugfix: stored items no longer loose their level on save/load
- engine: updated to unreal engine 4.16.1

notes.title: 2.5.4 Released - Multiplayer AI hotfix
notes.notes:
his is an attempt to fix the AI shutting down over a period of time on the multiplayer servers, this will also lower the CPU usage of AI on single player games. Sorry for two releases in a row but I wanted to solve this ASAP.

- bugfix: added basic collision to island statue
- bugfix: map fixes
- bugfix: ai behaves better in multiplayer now
- bugfix: ai deadlocking issue resolved
- bugfix: survival police station doors fixed

notes.title: 2.5.2 Released - More bug fixes
notes.notes:
Another pure bug-fix round, 
		translation: more complete version of Russian translation, but still Google Translate, please make suggestions for improvements if you see them.				new: guest mode logins, you can now sign in as your device unique ID (instead of just Google Play/Games ID)				tweak: turrets can now engage on a +/- 45 degree angle (was 20)		tweak: leveling your HP now does more for you (health skill + 10hp per level to level 10 - instead of +5 to 5) - extra health skills coming soon		tweak: brain cost for skills scales past level 5		tweak: zombies do less damage (no more one shot kills at level 1)		tweak: zombies back peddle (defensive maneuver) for way less time and do it slower		tweak: fall effect plays at least something on low sfx settings		tweak: attempted safe guard fix for exiting helicopters		tweak: clean up of helicopter rotors after destruction				bugfix: in multiplayer, you can now see the direction other players are looking (up/down)		bugfix: logging into multiplayer servers on android would sometimes mess up and you log in as a new characters		bugfix: when using up all of fuel, fuel can is removed from hands		bugfix: days survived,kills,deaths were not being saved between sessions		bugfix: npc loot tables adjusted, backpacks and shoulder pads can now drop, no invalid item drops		bugfix: zombie attack animations were sometimes not playing		bugfix: some things were not able to take damage		bugfix: turrets were not using levels/damage scaling system		bugfix: turrets were not saving correctly		bugfix: buildings not saving ownership			
Full change log - http://www.bitporters.net/zta/change_log.html

notes.title: 2.5.1 Released - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Still a lot more to do in 2.5.x but got a round of bug fixes out, stay tuned for more

new: more buildings have new open/close style doors
new: new water shader (disabled on low gfx settings)
new: crashed airplane now has lootable luggage around it
new: 4 new guns (creative mode only) to randomly spawn NPCs quickly
new: can spawn pigs from creative mode now
tweak: effects now scale based on graphic settings, on mobile devices these should be kept low (low by default)
tweak: newbton spawns loot way faster now
tweak: loot spawn also affected by # of people online, more people = more loot spawns
tweak: newbton and crashed airplane now spawn loot at a way faster rate
tweak: added ladder teleporters to pool in big city
tweak: smaller death match map - zombie/loot range adjusted to 1-255 instead of all 255
tweak: zombie spawners sets buildings to contain either survivor, zombie or bandit (so no more battle royale everywhere)
tweak: grenades are not stackable anymore (because they can be different levels), also no more grenade spam
bugfix: hp correctly updating on zombies, on destructible items
bugfix: on body explosion, camera stays where your body was
bugfix: build rotation keys added to key list (page up/page down)
bugfix: build mode toggle key works (tab)
bugfix: helicopter rotation controls added (left-right)
bugfix: clothing no longer gets stained by blood incorrectly
bugfix: if trying to build something and it doesn't work, couldnt build again until you reselected that item
bugfix: rotation of npcs are correct now compared to build preview
bugfix: sometimes when reconnecting your highlighted item in your hot bar was different than what you were holding
bugfix: if you buy a spawn point spawn, you can buy another one on your next death
bugfix: npcs hit at correct damage level now
bugfix: damage scaling works correctly with grenades and RPGs now

notes.title: 2.5.0 Released - the "things to do" release
notes.notes:
The major goal of 2.5 is to create more things to do in the game - the 3 major parts are new NPCs, dungeons, and a reason to go into the dungeons (scaled gear).  More dungeons will be added soon.

	Unreal Engine: 4.15.1
	---------
	
		new: new npc types (bandits, more zombies, pigs) 
		new: dungeons - first dungeon The Hospital has been introduced.  More to come real soon.	
		new: inventory screen and equip screen - split out into different tabs)
		new: npcs now have levels, 1-255
		new: weapons and armor now have levels 1-255
		new: armor also has TIERS, ie. a tier 1 hat (i.e a baseball cap) is worse than a tier 4 hat (i.e military hat)
		new: dungeon browser tab added to map
		new: spawn point screen updated
		new: random spawn accounts for level of you vs the spawn points, ie. wont put newbs in level 200 land
		new: new AI system, enemies engage in different ways depending on type.
		new: settings window - sound levels can now be managed
		new: host menu - game host can now adjust name of game and host settings from within the game.
		new: PC version very close - if you buy pro on android, email service@bitporters.net your GPA# and I will give you a steam key (i.e. GPA.XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXX)
		new: dash screen has quick buttons to chat options + selfie cam for screenshots.
		new: pre-launch game settings window, can now adjust amount of zombies/survivors/bandits/animals
		
		bugfix: better in game crash reporting
		tweak: upgrade to unreal 4.15
		tweak: when a weapon/armor breaks, it doesn't dissapear, it just becomes unusable/doesnt grant protection
		tweak: more brains granted if you share the game on social media, thank you for supporting this game.
		tweak: NPC spawner only spawns specific NPCs at specific times of the day
		
		android: only pro accounts can buy brains
		android: buying pro unlocks all the game modes
		translations updated
	
	
Full change log here - www.bitporters.net/zta/change_log.html
